videos.titleEn: How are microchips made? Episode 6 | ASML Nanoland

videos.scope: 本課「砷化鎵射頻元件製作」的延伸背景。以製造全貌辨認沉積、微影與蝕刻如何反覆建立不同層。 影片並非本課每一道步驟的實拍。
videos.scopeEn: Related background for Gallium-arsenide RF-device fabrication. Identify how repeated deposition, lithography and etching construct different layers. It is not footage of every step in this course.
watchFor: 辨認晶圓、晶粒和電晶體的不同尺度。
找出微影形成光阻圖案與蝕刻轉移圖案的差別。
記下影片簡化或省略的量測、清洗與重複工序。
watchForEn: Distinguish wafer, die and transistor scales.
Separate resist pattern formation from pattern transfer by etching.
Note metrology, cleaning and repeated operations simplified or omitted in the animation.
videos.before: 先問：「HBT 與 pHEMT：建立模型」需要哪種材料或介面證據？畫出本課與影片案例的共同處及不同處。
videos.beforeEn: Ask what material or interface evidence HBT versus pHEMT: construct and analyze requires. Draw the common ground and differences between this course and the video case.
videos.after: 把「隔離與漏電：建立模型」列為查證任務：半絕緣基板不保證表面無漏電；隔離測試需涵蓋偏壓極性。
videos.afterEn: Follow-up evidence task for Isolation and leakage: construct and analyze: A semi-insulating substrate does not guarantee no surface leakage; Isolation tests need bias-polarity coverage.

guides.title: 砷化鎵射頻元件製作：影像判讀與證據工作簿
guides.titleEn: Gallium-arsenide RF-device fabrication: visual evidence workbook
guides.concept: 先用「HBT 與 pHEMT：建立模型」建立判讀邊界。機制：同為 GaAs RF 元件不代表相同控制機制。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with HBT versus pHEMT: construct and analyze to define the interpretation boundary. Mechanism: GaAs RF devices need not share a control mechanism. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜HBT 與 pHEMT：建立模型：同為 GaAs RF 元件不代表相同控制機制；HBT 與 HEMT 的輸入阻抗不同。
觀察站 2｜隔離與漏電：建立模型：半絕緣基板不保證表面無漏電；隔離測試需涵蓋偏壓極性。
觀察站 3｜技術選擇：故障判讀與驗證：最佳製程取決於系統角色；匹配網路損耗會改變系統最佳選擇。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | HBT versus pHEMT: construct and analyze: GaAs RF devices need not share a control mechanism; HBT and HEMT input impedances differ.
Observation station 2 | Isolation and leakage: construct and analyze: A semi-insulating substrate does not guarantee no surface leakage; Isolation tests need bias-polarity coverage.
Observation station 3 | Technology selection: diagnose and verify: The preferred process depends on system role; Matching-network losses change system-level choices.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「隔離與漏電：建立模型」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「技術選擇：故障判讀與驗證」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Isolation and leakage: construct and analyze: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Technology selection: diagnose and verify to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 若採用「用同一閘極模型描述 HBT 基極」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
若採用「只看基板名稱便取消隔離測試」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: If using the claim "Describing an HBT base with an unchanged gate model", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.
If using the claim "Skipping isolation tests because of the substrate label", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.
An official demonstration need not show this course’s exact process; a general example is not product qualification.

courses.overview: 從「砷化鎵射頻元件製作」延伸比較氮化鎵高電子遷移率電晶體、矽鍺選擇性磊晶：先區分量測量與失效機制，再判斷哪些原理可轉用、哪些條件必須重新驗證。
courses.overviewEn: Extend Gallium-arsenide RF-device fabrication by comparing Gallium-nitride high-electron-mobility transistors and Selective silicon-germanium epitaxy: distinguish measurands and failure mechanisms before deciding what transfers and what needs fresh validation.

related.transfer: GaN HEMT 與 GaAs RF 元件都依賴異質結構、低寄生接觸及高頻量測，需同時看增益與效率。
related.transferEn: GaN HEMTs and GaAs RF devices use heterostructures, low-parasitic contacts and RF characterization, balancing gain and efficiency.
related.difference: GaAs 可採 HBT 或 pHEMT，不能把所有 GaAs 都當 HEMT；材料、載子注入及熱設計與 GaN 並不等同。
related.differenceEn: GaAs may use HBT or pHEMT architectures; not every GaAs device is a HEMT. Materials, injection and thermal design differ from GaN.
practice: 分別畫 HBT 與 HEMT 的載子控制方式。
拆分接觸、閘極及互連寄生。
對齊頻率、偏壓與功率條件後再比較效率。
practiceEn: Draw carrier control in an HBT and a HEMT.
Separate contact, gate and interconnect parasitics.
Match frequency, bias and power before comparing efficiency.
related.title: 氮化鎵高電子遷移率電晶體

related.whyEn: GaN HEMTs and GaAs RF devices use heterostructures, low-parasitic contacts and RF characterization, balancing gain and efficiency.

related.transfer: 異質磊晶都須分析晶格差、應變、鬆弛及接面品質，材料轉換前先檢查缺陷機制。
related.transferEn: Heteroepitaxy requires analysis of lattice mismatch, strain, relaxation and junction quality before transferring a process concept.
related.difference: SiGe 常用於矽系統的應變或源汲極工程；GaAs RF 元件可能採不同基板與 HBT／pHEMT 架構，熱預算與缺陷容忍度不同。
related.differenceEn: SiGe often supports strain or source/drain engineering in silicon; GaAs RF devices may use different substrates and HBT/pHEMT architectures with different thermal budgets and defect tolerances.
practice: 分開晶格失配與熱膨脹失配。
比較界面差排對通道與接面的影響。
建立不能直接移植的材料及熱史條件表。
practiceEn: Separate lattice mismatch from thermal-expansion mismatch.
Compare interfacial-dislocation effects on channels and junctions.
Tabulate material and thermal-history conditions that cannot be transferred directly.

courses.summary: 本課以「imec 魯汶研究園區（Tower 代表點）」作為公開研究、量測或產業歷史的代表地點。從HBT 與 pHEMT、閘長與寄生到技術選擇：以 12 項工程決策、24 個模型與診斷工作包建立證據。 技術由多個地區、企業與研究團隊共同發展；地圖不是唯一發明地，也不是未公開生產設施定位。
courses.summaryEn: This course uses imec Leuven research campus: Tower reference as a public research, metrology or industrial-history reference. From HBT versus pHEMT and Gate length and parasitics to Technology selection: build evidence through twelve engineering decisions and twenty-four modeling/diagnostic work packages. Multiple regions and institutions develop these technologies; the map is neither an exclusive invention claim nor undisclosed production coordinates.
